HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen decides, for no particular reason, to do nothing at all today.

description_variants.description: An Isolan decides, for no particular reason, to do nothing at all today.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: (name1) decides, for no particular reason, to do nothing at all today. (He/she) lies in the shade, watches the clouds, eats when (he/she)'s hungry and naps when (he/she)'s tired. By the evening (he/she) feels better than (he/she) has in weeks. Nobody at the camp thinks there is anything wrong with that.
